metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Jakarta Bay, Indonesia (coastal area) - Date: As of 2021 (use data up to end of 2021) - Collection: Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2 for land cover classification - I'll use Sentinel-2 (higher resolution) to detect artificial/built-up land 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clear views of the bay - Use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or classification to identify artificial surfaces - Focus on the offshore/coastal area where new land reclamation occurs 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid result: Calculate built-up area in hectares; compare to 800 ha threshold - C1: No images found for Jakarta Bay in 2021 - C2: All pixels masked out (too cloudy) - C3: Invalid calculations (negative area, NaN) - A: Built-up area > 800 ha - B: Built-up area ≤ 800 ha ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Jakarta Bay coastal area (approximate bounding box) const jakartaBay = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([106.6, -6.3, 107.0, -5.9]); // Use Sentinel-2 data for 2021 const startDate = '2021-01-01'; const endDate = '2021-12-31'; let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const imgCount = col.size().getInfo(); print(`2021 Images: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { print("No Sentinel-2 images found, trying Landsat 8..."); col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const lsCount = col.size().getInfo(); print(`Landsat 8 Images: ${lsCount}`); if (lsCount === 0) { print("No data found for Jakarta Bay in 2021."); print("C1"); return; } } // Create median composite let img = col.median(); // For Sentinel-2: Calculate NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) // NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) // B11 = SWIR, B8 = NIR const ndbi = img.normalizedDifference(['B11', 'B8']).rename('ndbi'); // Classify as built-up where NDBI > 0.1 (threshold for artificial surfaces) const builtUp = ndbi.gt(0.1).rename('buildup'); // Calculate pixel count const pixelCount = builtUp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jakartaBay, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('buildup').getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === 0) { print("No valid pixels after processing."); print("C2"); return; } // Calculate area of built-up pixels // Sentinel-2 resolution: 10m per pixel = 100 m² per pixel // 1 hectare = 10,000 m² const pixelAreaM2 = 100; const pixelAreaHa = pixelAreaM2 / 10000; const totalBuiltUpAreaHa = pixelCount * pixelAreaHa; print(`Built-up area: ${totalBuiltUpAreaHa.toFixed(2)} hectares`); print(`Threshold: 800 hectares`); if (isNaN(totalBuiltUpAreaHa) || totalBuiltUpAreaHa < 0) { print("Invalid calculation result."); print("C3"); return; } if (totalBuiltUpAreaHa > 800) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
